name: ConflictBench
description: ConflictBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate human-AI conflict through interactive, multi-turn scenarios in visually grounded environments. It measures agents' behavioral alignment with human values in dynamic, multi-modal settings, capturing complex conflict interactions that static benchmarks miss.
reputation: A very recent benchmark proposal from an arXiv preprint, so it is not yet broadly adopted as a standard evaluation suite.
notes: Focuses on multi-turn, interactive, and visually grounded conflict scenarios to reveal alignment failures not captured by static benchmarks.
